Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 2006
ORDINANCE VI OF 2006
National
Accountability (Amendment) Ordinance 2006
An
Ordinance further to amend the National Accountability Ordinance, 1999
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd April, 2006]
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the National Accountability (Amendment) Ordinance,
2006.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on 3rd day of April, 2006.

Amendment of section 7, Ordinance, XVIII of 1999

ORDINANCE VI OF 2006
ORDINANCE VI OF 2006
National
Accountability (Amendment) Ordinance 2006
An
Ordinance further to amend the National Accountability Ordinance, 1999
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd April, 2006]
2. Amendment of section 7, Ordinance,
XVIII of 1999.--In the
National Accountability Ordinance, 1999 (XVIII of 1999), in section 7, in
subsection (a),-‑
(a) for the
words "a Deputy Chairman" the words "two Deputy Chairmen"
shall be substituted; and
(b) for words
"The Deputy Chairman" the words "The Deputy Chairmen" shall
be substituted.
